text.autoelytra.title: Auto Elytra Firework Boost
text.autoelytra.enabled.tooltip: Boost with a firework when flying with an elytra and the boost key is pressed.
text.autoelytra.jump: Also respond to the vanilla Jump key
text.autoelytra.jump.tooltip: Only while elytra-flying. If disabled, only the mod's own key works (default: Space). It can be changed under Options -> Controls.
text.autoelytra.skipGlideStart: Don't boost on the press that starts gliding
text.autoelytra.skipGlideStart.tooltip: Sequence: 1st press = jump, 2nd press = start elytra gliding, 3rd press = firework boost. Turn off to boost on the same press that starts gliding.
text.autoelytra.cooldown.tooltip: Minimum delay between two automatic uses, measured in game ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
text.autoelytra.plain.tooltip: Rockets without firework stars. These only give the elytra boost and never explode near you.
text.autoelytra.explosive.tooltip: Rockets that contain firework stars and explode. Disabled by default.
text.autoelytra.flight.tooltip: Select which flight durations may be used automatically.
text.autoelytra.offhand: Also take rockets from the offhand
text.autoelytra.offhand.tooltip: A rocket in the offhand can be used temporarily and is put back afterwards.
text.autoelytra.offhandFirst.tooltip: When the offhand holds a usable rocket, use it before any rocket found elsewhere in the inventory.
text.autoelytra.msg.suppressed: Elytra opened; press Space again to launch a firework rocket
text.autoelytra.msg.noRocket: No usable firework found (check reserve count and type filters)
text.autoelytra.reserve.tooltip: While searching the inventory, the mod does not touch any rocket when the total amount of usable rockets is not greater than this value. The main hand and the offhand (active-use slots) are not affected by this limit.
text.autoelytra.priority.tooltip: Which eligible stack to use first when several rockets match the filters.
